title: Resonance in the carbonate ion
caption: Three equivalent Lewis structures differ only in which oxygen carries the double bond. The real ion is a hybrid: the two negative charges and the π electrons are spread over all three C–O bonds, which are identical in length.
alt: Three structures of carbonate, each with the C=O to a different oxygen, joined by double-headed resonance arrows.
description: Each structure: carbon bonded to three oxygens, one by a double bond, two singly bonded oxygens each carrying a negative charge.
The double bond is to a different oxygen in each.
note: The real ion is the average: each C–O bond is 1⅓ bonds and each O carries −⅔.
